༄༅/ /bla ma'i rim pa dngos grub rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma'i rim pa dngos grub rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /

dpal ldan bla ma lha yi lha/ /yid bzhin mchog la phyag 'tshal te/ /de mnyes byed pa'i rim pa ni/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho bri bar bya/ 'di la gsum ste/ bsten bya bla ma'i rang bzhin/ bsten byed slob ma'i chos/ ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bkod pa chen po las/ mkhas shing bya ba bral ba dang*/ /chos nyid don la tshad phebs dang*/ /'dod pa'i don la rmongs pa med/ /gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa las/ mkhas pa de yang spyir grub pa'i mtha' la mkhas pas/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i khyad phyed pa/ bye brag tu rdo rje theg pa'i don la mkhas pas rgyud sde'i dgongs pa shes pa/ nyams myong dang drod tshad la mkhas pas rtogs pa gong mar phyin pa'o/ /bya ba bral ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang mtshan mas rnam par g.yeng ba med pas gcig pur dben par gnas shing*/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rnam pa la dal chags shing khong yangs pas gzung 'dzin dang spros pa chung ba'o/ /chos nyid kyi don la tshad du phebs pa ni/ chos nyid mngon sum gyi don la mkhas shing nyams su blangs pas goms tshad phul du phyin pa'i drod rtags yod pa'o/ /'dod pa'i don la rmongs pa med pa ni/ slob mas gang dris pa'i don ston par nus shing*/ bskyed rim phrin las bzhi'i lag len mthong ba brgyud pa'i gdams ngag yod pa'o/ /rdzogs rim lta sgom spyod pa'i rang bzhin thugs nyams su bzhes pas nyams rtogs gong 'phel du bskyed par nus pa/ rdo rje lus kyi bkod pa la brten nas rtsa thig rlung gsum gnad du bsnun pa'i nyams len la ma rmongs pa'o/ /de rnams dang ldan na/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhes bya ba ste/ 'dir gsol ba gdab pa'i 'os yin no/ / gnyis pa bsten byed slob ma'i chos la lnga las/ dang po mnyes par byed pa'i thabs ni/ de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa la gdams ngag mnos nas rab sgrub pa'i zhabs tog gis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa zin pa/

'bring lus ngag gi zhabs tog gis sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyang ba/ tha ma zang zing gi yo byad kyis tshogs gnyis kyi bre kha khengs pa gang rung zhig cis kyang bya'o/ /gnyis pa mnyes pa'i phan yon ni/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa 'dag cing kun gyis mthong na dga' ba dang*/ bsod nams dang 'byor pa 'phel zhing mkha' 'gros stong grogs byed pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad dga' ba med par thob pa ste/ dam tshig mchog gi rgyud pas/ /dngos grub 'dod pa'i dad pa can/ /dngos grub bla ma mnyes las 'byung*/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ma mnyes pa'i nyes pa ni/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ bla la la ni smod pa dang*/ / thugs dkrugs pa yi nyes pa ni/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po las/ /chu thigs skra yis gtor nus pa/ /de yi tshad du dmyal bar ltung*/ /rdo rje dmyal bar grags pa yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /slob dpon la ni gang smod pa/ /tshe 'di nyid la sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang*/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis 'tshe ba dang*/ /gdon dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar lhung*/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa bshags pa'i thabs ni/ tshogs kyis bskangs nas ci mnyes pas thugs bzung ste bshags shing*/ lus kyis nyes na bla ma'i don du lus bkol nas gsol/ ngag gis nyes na/ bla ma'i yon tan phyogs bcur bsgrags shing*/ / yid kyis mos gus dang yon tan bsam pa gtso bo yin no/ /de'ang rang lo'i grangs las nyes pa mang bar gyur na gsor mi rung ste/ dam tshig bkod pa las/ gal te bla mar brnyas pa'i mis/ /lan grangs bdun nam bcu dag la/ /'gyod pa byas te bshags pas byang*/ /rang lo 'das nas bshags pa'i yul/ /rdo rje sems dpas ma gnang ngo*/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa dag pa'i tshad ni/ /'gyod tshangs drag po byas pas sor chud pa'i rtags su/

bla ma sngar mnyes dus ltar/ dngos su thugs 'khon byang ba dang*/ rmi lam du nyes pa med par lung ston pa dang*/ nyi zla shar ba la sogs pa sdig pa dag pa'i rtags rnams 'byung ngo*/ / don gsum pa ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul la gsum las/ dang po spyir bsten pa'i tshul ni/ nad pas sman pa bsten pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i nad las thar ba'i don du/ lus ngag yid gsum gus pas g.yo zol med par sri zhu dang*/ phu dud bya zhing gru 'dod pas mnyen pa bsten pa ltar 'khor bas 'jigs nas rtag tu ci gsung nyan pa dang*/ tshong pas ded dpon bsten pa ltar thar pa 'dod pas rim gror cher bya'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bsgom zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ nyin mtshan thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed nas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i ngang las/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dkar po dang nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor bsam pa'i nang na/ a dkar po las 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan drangs nas/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dang chos 'brel yod tshad thams cad thim pa'i mthar/ y-i dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bsams te/ yid kyis mchod cing bstod la/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig po/ /'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs/ /thar pa'i lam skas chen po ste/ /ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la/ /mun pa'i tshogs dag skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /dug gsum me yis gdungs pa la/ /rang byung rlan gyis bsil bar brjod/ /ma rig 'khrul pas bcings pa yi/ /rdos bcas lus ngag yid rnams kun/ /rang dengs 'od kyi rang bzhin tu/ /lhag med mya ngan 'das thob mdzod/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che/ /bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzod la/

/'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol/ /tshe 'dir legs pa kun 'grub cing*/ / bgegs dang bar chad med pa dang*/ /'chi khar zab mo'i 'od gsal zin/ / bar do'i 'phrang las sgrol bar mdzod/ /lus dang ngag yid brtsams pa kun/ /rtag tu gzhan la phan pa dang*/ /rkyen rnams byang chub lam mchog tu/ /de ring nyid nas bsgyur du gsol/ /bdag gis 'bad kyang thar pa dka'/ /mgon po khyed kyi thugs rje'i grus/ /mgon med bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /thar pa'i gling du phyin par mdzod/ /gang dag bdag la dad gyur tam/ /smod dam skur ba 'debs kyang rung*/ /de dag sdig zad nyon mongs med/ /srid pa'i chu bo spang bar shog /nam zhig bdag gi ming tsam gyis/ / 'gro ba'i 'dod dgu rab sgrub cing*/ /phyogs bcu gang ba'i zhing rnams su/ / mchod pa'i sprin gyis char 'bebs shog /dge ba 'di yis lus can kun/ / thams cad srid la rnam grol nas/ /ye shes dam pa gnyis thob ste/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ zhabs kyi mthe bong las/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo nas lus phyi nang thams cad la khyab pas/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku'i dngos grub thob/ mgrin par babs/ ngag gi sgrib pa dang*/ gsung gi dngos grub thob/ snying khar babs/ yid kyi sgrib pa dang*/ thugs kyis dngos grub thob/ lte bar babs/ dri ma thams cad dag /yon tan gyi dngos grub thob/ gsang bar babs/ phrin las kyi dngos grub thob/ bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa'i ngang der dar cig glod la bsgom mo/ /rjes la snang ba thams cad bla ma'i sku/ grags pa thams cad bla ma'i gsung*/ dran rig thams cad bla ma'i thugs su gsal ba'i ngang la bsngo ba byas te/ rmi lam sgyu ma tsam gyis spyod lam gyi bya ba rnams bya'o/ /de'ang zhen pa yod pa'i las dang po pas ni/ bying na rang nyid bla ma la thims nas mi dmigs pa dang*/

rgod na bla ma rang la thim nas brjod du med pa'i ngang du bzhag nas bsngo ba byed pa yin no/ /de ltar nyin mtshan gyi thun bzhir bsgoms pas/ dngos su lus ngag yid gsum bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnas shing*/ rmi lam du bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gros lung ston pa dang*/ chos 'chad pa la sogs pa grub pa'i rtags rnams 'byung ba yin no/ / gsum pa de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu ni/ dngos grub thams cad 'grub cing ma 'ongs pa na rang nyid khams gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi sku sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dam pa 'thob ste/ sgra thal 'gyur las/ bsten pa de las yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba las/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa 'thob/ /de la dmigs te bla ma bsten/ /'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog phyir ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ chub par rol pa'i rgyud las/ bskyed rim bskal pa gsum bsgoms pas/ /bla ma mnyes pa'i bsod nams ni/ /dpag gis dpog pa ma yin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pa las kun mkhyen pa'i/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ bla ma dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi/ /dbang phyug longs spyod lngas mchod na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa yin/ /nye ba'i dkyil 'khor smos ci dgos/ /nyes pa thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ /yon tan mchog rnams thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dpal ldan yon tan mchog gis yongs gang ba/ /srid gsum 'dren pa'i bla ma dam pa la/ /'di phyi'i don 'grub slad du gus pas bsten/ /rnam grol yon tan mdzod mang thob par 'gyur/ /dus rnams rtag tu drin yang mi brjed pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag /de mnyes pa las yon tan kun 'byung bas/ /skal ldan rnams kyis gtsang ma'i spyi bos bsten/

/mdzad spyod phrin las rnam bzhi'i rjes 'gro ba/ /zhi dang khro tshul sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul/ /dgongs spyod rgya mtsho dpag gis mi lang ba/ /de 'dra'i bla ma g.yo med gus pas bsten/ /spyir yang dag dang ma dag rang snang ste/ /rang skyon dag na gzhan skyon mthong mi srid/ /rang la skyon yon spel mar ldan pa na/ /gzhan la'ang de mthong dad gus res 'jog tsam/ /rang rgyud dul na thams cad grogs su 'char/ /de bas dag snang mos gus kun la bya/ /snang srid snod bcud thams cad bla mar 'char/ /mi rtag gtad med rang bzhin med par stogs/ /'di dag kho bo'i snying gtam mchog yin pas/ /dgra gnyen bar ma cir snang thams cad la/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar can yin zhes/ /snying nas sems gdul rang skyon 'ba' zhig brtag /nyin mtshan kun tu skad cig ma yengs par/ /bla ma mchog dang gdams pa'i yon tan bsam/ /'chi ba rjes dran bskul mas lcag 'debs bya/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i yon tan bsam/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' chos dang 'phrad pa dkon/ /de bas rtag tu chos dang sems bsres la/ /chos min bya ba cung zad mi bsam mo/ /chos spyod chos sgrub chos la nyin mtshan 'bad/ /legs pa'i yon tan kun 'byung yid bzhin yin/ /de skad bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /sems dang chos 'dis thar pa'i lam song ste/ /rang rgyud btul nas gzhan rgyud smin byas shing*/ /phyam cig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gsang ba snying tig gi bla ma'i rim pa dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (9)bla ma'i rim pa dngos grub rgya mtsho/ - PAGE 184 -- PAGE 183 -- PAGE 177 -
